'''Arthree''' was an [[R3-series astromech droid/Legends|R3-series astromech droid]] who belonged to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jhensara]]. Arthree was one of three droids on the ship alongside [[Artoo (Jhensara)|Artoo]] and [[Arfive (Jhensara)|Arfive]].
